title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability… (CVE-2026-132732)
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki Math Extension affecting versions 1.43, 1.45, 1.46, and 1.47. The issue arises from improper neutralization of input during web page generation in specific program files. This vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.3. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
